newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AND PSV SUFFER SURPRISE DEFEATS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AND PSV SUFFER SURPRISE DEFEATS.

text.p: Champions Ajax Amsterdam and leaders PSV Eindhoven suffered surprising defeats in the Dutch soccer leager on Sunday.

Ajax lost 2-0 at NAC Breda and PSV were beaten 1-0 by lowly Willem II Tilburg, but with second place Feyenoord losing on Friday the situation stayed unchanged at the top with PSV one point clear on 36.
Ajax, who play Auxerre in the European champions league on Wednesday and Feyenoord away next Sunday, dropped to sixth overall on goal difference, behind three other teams with 27 points.
Ajax, who may have to add Kiki Musampa and Marcio Santos to the already long list of absentees, impresed for a brief period after halftime.

But they were already trailing to a fine 13th minute solo goal from Australian defender Tony Vidmar and a 36th minute strike from American international striker Ernest Stewart. The goal was laid on by Norwegian midfielder Tom Kare Staurvik, who was making his debut for NAC after being loaned from Rosenborg BK until the end of the season.

PSV started strongly against Willem II, but failed to score an early goal, and looked to be taking things too easily when Bert Konterman ended off a 74th minute solo run with a shot under keeper Ronald Waterreus.
PSV coach Dick Advocaat reacted by taking off defender Stan Valckx for striker Marcelo, but to no avail.
